_comment: Tier-2 for skfem nonlinear#1 (previously 'claim inherited'). Measured on skfem 12.0.1 with -div((1+u^2) grad u) = 10 on MeshTri().refined(3)/P1: the exact linearisation assembled fresh each iteration with basis.interpolate(u_prev) converges quadratically (each residual roughly the square of the previous, reaching machine precision in six steps); dropping the 2 u du term leaves a Picard-style operator whose residual ratio is roughly CONSTANT near 0.1, i.e. linear. Ratios and thresholds only, no residual pinned.
